specialRules.ruleFull: The warband has no standing leader. At the start of each battle the hero with the highest Leadership takes the role and has the Leader skill for that battle; where no hero clearly has it, the hero with the most experience leads.

Write down which buildings are rigged: one building for each hero or henchmen group with the Trap Master skill. The first model to enter a rigged building must pass an Initiative test or take one Strength 3 hit.
For every other member of the warband within 3", the Baron gains +1 Leadership, to a maximum of +3.
One hero within 6" of the Elder may re-roll one dice each turn.
Greycoats may set traps, as the warband's Traps rule describes.
Mummers may never rise to power: re-roll any Lad's Got Talent result they roll for experience.

specialSkillsList.name: Expert Explorer
specialSkillsList.description: The warrior may change one dice in the exploration phase by +1 or -1.

specialSkillsList.name: Trap Master
specialSkillsList.description: The warrior may lay traps, as the warband's Traps rule describes.

specialSkillsList.name: Silent Strike
specialSkillsList.description: The warrior may shoot while hidden without giving his position away.

flags.what: A Lost warband needs at least 3 models: our templates hold no minimum, so it is not imported. No henchmen group sizes and no maximum profiles are printed, so the warband takes our Human race.
A Baron starts with 15 + D6 experience: the template stores 15, and the roll is the player's.

Choice of Warriors (p1) allows up to five Greycoats, while the Greycoat entry (p5) is headed "0-2": the count is taken as 0-5, with Mummers 0-5 as Choice of Warriors has them (their entry prints no number).
The warband has no standing leader: the hero with the highest Leadership leads each battle, so no fighter is marked the leader and the template's checks warn that it has none.
The skill table: the Baron ticks Combat, Shooting, Strength, Speed and Special, the Elder Academic and Special, and the Greenjack Combat, Shooting, Strength and Speed with no Special.

The special skills: Wall Runner is ours, the same effect (ours is worded for a Skaven and carries a suggested change). Expert Explorer does what our Resource Hunter, Seeker (Wood Elves of Athel Loren) and Treasure Hunter do, and Silent Strike what our Sniper does: both are kept apart. A decision for William.
The Greycoat's profile row is labelled "Trapper": read as the Greycoat's, the entry it sits under.
The Mummer's and the Scavenger's Weapons/Armour lines both name the Scavengers: read as each entry's own fighter, both from the Lost equipment list.
Brutes (re-roll a Lad's Got Talent result) is read as Mummers not being promotable, and his rule carries the re-roll.
The Lost list's Sword is marked "(heroes only)"; its armour is a Helmet and Light Armour only, and the Greycoats list prints "Armour: None".
